ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES — MOCK EXAM #16
====

GRADE: Grade 2
SUBJECT: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Heating until a solid melts
   B. A chemical reaction forming ash
   C. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   D. Movement of water only across a membrane

2. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. watt (W)
   B. pascal (Pa)
   C. joule (J)
   D. newton (N)

3. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Milk souring
   B. Ice melting to water
   C. Paper burning to ash
   D. Iron rusting

4. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   B. Removing all vegetation
   C. Overgrazing continuously
   D. Burning crop residue every week

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Water its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Water its resources.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Water its resources.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Water its resources.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Water its resources.

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Forming shadows in light? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Forming shadows in light.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Forming shadows in light.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Forming shadows in light.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Forming shadows in light.

7. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any substance that conducts electricity
   B. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   C. Any white crystal used in cooking
   D. A mixture of two liquids

8. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   B. Water always increases oxygen
   C. Water removes heat too quickly
   D. Petrol fires have no fuel

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Recording weather? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Recording weather.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Recording weather.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Recording weather.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Recording weather.

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Energy: Light its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Energy: Light its resources.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Energy: Light its resources.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Energy: Light its resources.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Energy: Light its resources.

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Safety when handling? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Safety when handling.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Safety when handling.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Safety when handling.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Safety when handling.

12. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Primary consumers only
   B. Decomposers only
   C. Tertiary consumers
   D. Producers

13. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Weather its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Weather its resources.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Weather its resources.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Weather its resources.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Weather its resources.

14. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only water vapour
   B. Nitrogen gas only
   C. Glucose and oxygen
   D. Only carbon dioxide

15. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   B. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   C. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   D. A mixture always has a fixed melting point

16. Which practice best shows correct science when studying School environment environment? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to School environment environment.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on School environment environment.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for School environment environment.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about School environment environment.

17. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Precautions when using? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Precautions when using.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Precautions when using.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Precautions when using.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Precautions when using.

18. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 37 °C
   B. 100 °C
   C. 50 °C
   D. 0 °C

19. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Animals resources? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Animals resources.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Animals resources.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Animals resources.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Animals resources.

20. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Soil and its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Soil and its resources.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Soil and its resources.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Soil and its resources.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Soil and its resources.

21. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Transporting? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Transporting.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Transporting.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Transporting.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Transporting.

22. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Interpreting? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Interpreting.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Interpreting.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Interpreting.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Interpreting.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
23. In three clear sentences, explain Precautions when using and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

24. In three clear sentences, explain School environment environment and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

25. In three clear sentences, explain Keeping and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

26. In three clear sentences, explain Keeping Safe and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

27. In three clear sentences, explain The National and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

28. In three clear sentences, explain The National and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

29. In three clear sentences, explain Child Rights and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

30. In three clear sentences, explain School rules and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
